violations.text: Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair, door hinge loose, and interior door insulation was exposed on prep unit. Technician has been on-site, parts are being ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Soda tap drain tube was observed draining into 3-bay sink. PIC stated service on lines is scheduled for 6/8/26; technician to directly connect drain tube to a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (drink garnishes) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Staff disposed, PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

A rag and spray bottles were observed on the hand-washing sink at the bar; a bucket was observed in the hand-washing sink in the dish room. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026
Sticker residue was observed on several stacked hotel pans and plastic containers. PIC brought to have labels removed, cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Juice was observed held at 49 degrees Fahrenheit in bar refrigerator. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Juice was disposed; fruits were placed in other refrigeration. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

The bar refrigeration unit was observed in poor repair, not maintaining an ambient temperature of 41 degrees F or below. The prep unit in the kitchen was observed with a condensate leak. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair, a door hinge observed loose, and interior door insulation was exposed on the kitchen prep unit. PIC stated owner is aware and gaskets are on order. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep unit have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
The faucets at the 3-bay sink were non-functional at the time of this inspection. Flush spray was usable at the time of this inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
Soda tap drain tube was observed draining into 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Trash and grease debris was observed around establishment's dumpster and grease receptacle in the shared refuse area. Refuse areas must be maintained clean and free of debris to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025

The doors to the outside are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2025

The cold drawers were observed non-functional at the time of inspection, with food held on ice. PIC stated that repair and/or new unit is scheduled for tomorrow. Foods were moved to alternative refrigeration. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2025
Trash and debris were observed in the common areas around the dumpster area. Refuse areas are to be maintained clean to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025

The following have an accumulation of soil residue and debris: -walk-in gaskets -beverage tubing covering (in walk-in) -floor/wall junctures in basement storage area. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025
Coving near basement stairs observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2024

Sanitizer and wash buckets were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Buckets removed during inspections. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2024
The door to the prep unit was not in good repair. Inspector observed interior panel missing and exposed insulation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2024

The floor and wall junctures in the 3 bay sink area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/30/2024
